objective: Prove that a bounded state/phase-conditioned learned physical knee-target residual can be inserted into the frozen Stage219 controller with exact zero behavior before any optimizer update.

source.reason: Phase63 through Phase66 rejected all constant and hand-coded mirrored shims; Phase66 isolated physical-side asymmetry that requires observation-conditioned learning rather than another fixed rule.

module_contract.output: two physical-radian knee target offsets mapped to lower-action dimensions 3 and 9
module_contract.standing_mask: clock norm squared <= 0.25 or invalid desired-contact suffix forces exact zero

decision_boundary.pass: Unlocks writing a new preregistration for one zero-start bounded-residual update only; it does not itself authorize or execute that update.
decision_boundary.fail: Blocks all learned-residual optimizer work until the zero-equivalence defect is fixed.
